preconditions.description: The number of rows and columns n must be between 1 and 100.
The number of ones k must be between 0 and 1000000.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' if k > n**2 else True
postconditions.description: If k is greater than the total number of elements in the matrix, output -1.

postconditions.expression: all(matrix[i][j] == matrix[j][i] for i in range(n) for j in range(n))
postconditions.description: The matrix must be symmetrical with respect to the main diagonal.

postconditions.expression: sum(sum(row) for row in matrix) == k
postconditions.description: The total number of ones in the matrix must equal k.
